Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.provisioning

@NullMarked package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.provisioning
Shared server preparation and isolated session inputs used by Maven provisioning and direct JUnit launches. Download metadata and server specifications describe prepared inputs independently of Maven's project model. Maven owns dependency selection; the framework owns each mutable test session and server process.
